objective: Recover KL formation lesson AI validation from repeated Edge Function 504 idle timeouts, preserve learners' answers as authorized drafts and block false completion or points awards.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only live MAIN Supabase function inspection and logs 2026-11-23 13:00–15:00 UTC: 3 HTTP 504 IDLE_TIMEOUT at ~150 seconds, 2 HTTP 503, 3 HTTP 200 from buklod-ai-validate-response v19. Live DB function checks strict account-bound gemini proof/answer hash/lesson hash. Main GitHub source 993fba1b is not an OTA production fingerprint. No actual device/RC runtime verified. Aggregate validation attempts from the last 24h show successful gemini-3.6-flash (24) and gemini-3.5-flash-lite (28), so those are the selected primary/fallback models.
chosenApproach: Restrict AI upstream to 40s gemini-3.6-flash primary and 17s gemini-3.5-flash-lite secondary using per-request AbortSignal.timeout; return 503 rather than fail-open; show recoverable client messages; reuse only same-content accepted validation receipts; store an account-authorized unapproved draft only if failure occurs before starting canonical completion RPC.
selectionRationale: Unbounded sequential Gemini attempts caused 150-second gateway idle timeouts. One primary bounded attempt plus one quick fallback caps response time while retaining authoritative model-scored proof. Existing idempotent draft endpoint preserves work without changing points, approval or chapter unlock.
alternativeApproaches: Bypass AI checker and automatically credit lessons during outages — rejected: violates source-based scoring, creates fraudulent points and prematurely unlocks chapters.
Retry all five upstream models or repeat the full five-question check on every tap — rejected: repeats 504 timeouts, wasted credit, poor weak-network performance.
Move all lesson validation into new asynchronous queues — deferred: requires additional schema/worker/privacy and client status flows outside this incident's narrow DEV scope.
preserveBehaviors: Only actual source-grounded Gemini attempts can meet official lesson completion and earn points. Failed AI calls never approve a learner.
Existing enrollment/lesson authorization, server-only points, chapter locks, five-field checking and accepted-answer thresholds remain authoritative.
Input text stays on screen; authorized draft writes do not falsely claim completion and never occur after the completion RPC has been attempted.
Ads still appear only as a best-effort after the verified database completion and never block saving or checking.
No new Android native dependencies, OTA, Godot, web deployment, database migrations or production Edge Function writes.
acceptanceChecks: Bounded primary/fallback Gemini calls terminate far below the previously observed 150-second idle timeout; non-2xx is reported as a retryable AI outage, not failed learner grade.
A verified accepted receipt reused for an unchanged lesson, question and answer; changed answer/lesson content requires fresh AI verification.
On upstream failure before completion, the authorized draft RPC saves answers without points, and the client never reports a completed lesson.
Offline/network/401/403/409 and duplicate tap cases do not bypass authorization; a confirmed server approval stays authoritative.
Supabase SQL guard validates live backend's account-bound, non-fail-open, model-scored source proof; mandatory engineering source CI and Android/ad/navigation gates are required before any RC.
No production backend deployment, OTA, web, Godot or Vercel publication from this isolated DEV PR.
